{{Quote|I dunno what everyone's talking about. It's nothing but more Thaereian plots. See, I told you all along! I told you about them, but did people listen? No! And now look at where we are. This is just a way for Thaere to mess with everyone inside Cularin. Nobody remembers that whole destabilization doc that got posted a while back? Huh? Look how it's wrote. Losers!|tharestinx, posting on the Cularin holonet node regarding the decrypted message shared by mstrslcr|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
An individual used the handle '''tharestinx''' as a user ID on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], thaerestinx participated in a discussion on a Cularin holonet node forum regarding evidence shared by the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] of a [[Thaereian military]] plot to cause social and economic disruption in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the discussion, the user criticized the slicer [[wampa1]] and also responded to a post by [[Westa Impeveri]],<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref> a counselor from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Sometime later, tharestinx contributed to a discussion on the Cularin holonet node regarding an intercepted message distributed by the user [[mstrslcr]] which some interpreted as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] report advocating for overhaul of the operation of the [[Almas Academy]]<ref name="academic review" /> a [[Jedi academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].<ref name="LFCG" />. Unconvinced that the report was Jedi in origin, tharestinx judged the message to be a hoax that had been perpetuated by the [[Thaereian]] military.<ref name="academic review" />.

Another time, a story was posted on the Cularin holonet node depicting an individual named "[[Nightwing]]" in the [[Thaereian military]], whom many identified as [[Osten Dal'Nay]], a high-profile Thaereian military defector, killing his superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Kulkis]]. Tharestinx saw no evidence that the story had been leaked as part of a Thaereian military conspiracy.<ref name="everyone's a critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>
